question: Urban Platter avocado oil parent company
markdown:
Urban Platter is owned and operated by its parent legal entity,
Istore Direct Trading Private Limited
, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mumbai, India by founder
Chirag Kenia
. The brand operates independently with strategic backing and investment from the
Jubilant Group
(Jubilant Bhartia).
